reviews.review: Great fun, good action. A little short, and sometimes a bit repetetive, but overall, lot of fun.
I played this game while I was in the hospital recovering from a lung surgery. Care to guess which I enjoyed more?

OH. MY. GOD. This game was absolutely amazing, incredibly fun, and pretty dificult on normal mode. (either that or i just really suck) I honestly have never had so much fun on any single game that I have ever played, this is truely awesome. Hopefully the sequel to it is equally or even better, since it does kinda set up for another game at the end. Although I never buy games when they first come out, I would definately get the sequel on the release date, even if it is $60. I highly recommend it to anyone that likes FPS's, but if your new to the War 40K universe, fear not for newcommers are not required to know much about the lore. And I still have to play multiplayer yet, since I put 9.8 hours into the incredibly long campaign. (But its not too long where you'll get borde, obviously)

12/10 would fall naked into pile of cactus to get a sequel.

Nothing beats making a running start and then slaming into your enemy. 
This game lets you do that. 
Nothing beats riding a jetpack 50 feet up into the air and then droping down on the head of your target and squishing it.
This game lets you do that.
Nothing beats swinging a giant hammer and sweping wave after wave of soft flesh as march into the head of a lion.
This game lets you do that.
But can it let you do that actual humans over an online gaming sesion?
Yes it can.
Does it let you fully customize your character with various colors, armor pieces and personalized weaponry?
Yes it does.
Can you heal by the blood of your enemy?
Yes.
Can you stand tall and unyielding as a monster twice your size charges at you teeth bearing and screaming for your death?

You can damn well try.
